77.text: faint sounds , not distinguishable before in the stillness

164.text: the cool dampness of a fine , misty rain on his face

358.text: the pitchy blackness of the cabin

126.text: a narrow valley , open and grassy , from which rose a faint murmur of running water

quotes.text: “Wal, Beasley, are you here?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Fellars, Beasley ain't here yet,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Put the hosses under the
shed. We'll wait.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Wait, huh!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Mebbe all night--an' we got nuthin' to
eat.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Shut up, Moze. Reckon you're no good for anythin' but eatin'. Put them
hosses away an' some of you rustle fire-wood in here.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Snake, it'd been sense to fetch a pack along,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Reckon so, Jim. But we didn't, an' what's the use hollerin'? Beasley
won't keep us waitin' long.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “It ain't a-goin' to rain much,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Jim, hyar's a chunk of pine log, dry as punk,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Snake, lemme your pipe, an' I'll hev a fire in a jiffy.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Wal, I want my terbacco an' I ain't carin' about no fire,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Reckon you're the meanest cuss in these woods,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Fire feels good,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Fall's sure a-comin'... Now if only we had some grub!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Moze, there's a hunk of deer meat in my saddle-bag, an' if you git it
you can have half,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Snake, what's this here deal with Beasley?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Reckon you'll l'arn when I do,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Ain't we done away with enough of them poor greaser herders--for
nothin'?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “You're dead right, Burt--an' that's my stand,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Snake, snow 'll be flyin' round these woods before
long,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Are we goin' to winter down in the Tonto Basin
or over on the Gila?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Reckon we'll do some tall ridin' before we strike south,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Boss, I heerd a hoss comin' up the trail,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “A-huh!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Ho there, inside!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Ho yourself!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “That you, Snake?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Reckon so,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Hullo, Snake! Hullo, Wilson!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“I've backed out on the other
deal. Sent for you on--on another little matter... particular private.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“A-huh! ejaculated Anson, dubiously. Then he turned abruptly. Moze,
you an' Shady an' Burt go wait outside. Reckon this ain't the deal I
expected.... An' you can saddle the hosses.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
